content:
Subject: Login page returns 500 error

Body:
I'm unable to log in to my account. Every time I enter my credentials and click 'Sign In', the page shows a 500 Internal Server Error. I've tried clearing my cache and using a different browser, but the issue persists. This is blocking me from accessing my dashboard and I have an urgent deadline tomorrow.
human_approved_draft: Thank you for reporting this issue. We've identified a server-side error affecting the login page. Our engineering team is actively investigating and we expect a fix to be deployed within the next 2 hours. In the meantime, you can try accessing your account via the mobile app as a workaround. We'll notify you once the issue is resolved.

content:
Subject: Request for dark mode feature

Body:
Hi, I'd love to see a dark mode option added to the application. Working late at night with a bright white background is really hard on my eyes. Many other apps have this feature and it would be a great quality-of-life improvement for users like me.
human_approved_draft: Thank you for the suggestion! We've noted your request for dark mode support. This feature is currently on our product roadmap and our team is evaluating the best approach to implement it. We appreciate your feedback as it helps us prioritize features that matter most to our users.

content:
Subject: Can't access my billing information

Body:
When I navigate to the billing section in my account settings, I get a blank page. I need to download my invoice for tax purposes but can't access it. I've tried multiple browsers and the issue is the same. Please help.
human_approved_draft: We understand how important it is to access your billing information. We've identified the issue with the billing section and our team is working on a fix. In the meantime, we can send your invoices directly to your registered email address. Would you like us to do that?

content:
Subject: CRITICAL - Production system down affecting all users

Body:
URGENT: Our entire production system is down. All users are unable to access the platform. This is affecting our business operations and we're losing revenue every minute. We need immediate assistance from your engineering team. This has been ongoing for 30 minutes.
human_approved_draft: We understand the severity of this situation and our senior engineering team has been immediately alerted. A dedicated incident response team is being mobilized right now. We will provide updates every 15 minutes until the issue is resolved. Please confirm your contact information so we can reach you directly.

content:
Subject: How do I export my data?

Body:
I'm trying to export my data from the platform but I can't find the export option. Could you guide me on how to do this? I need to export my project data in CSV format.
human_approved_draft: To export your data in CSV format, please follow these steps: 1. Navigate to your project dashboard, 2. Click on the 'Settings' tab, 3. Select 'Data Export' from the left sidebar, 4. Choose CSV as your format and click 'Export'. The download will begin automatically. If you encounter any issues, let us know.

content:
Subject: Unauthorized charge on my credit card

Body:
I noticed an unauthorized charge of $99.99 on my credit card statement from your company. I did not make this purchase and I need this investigated immediately. I want a refund and want to make sure my account hasn't been compromised. This is very concerning.
human_approved_draft: We take unauthorized charges very seriously. We've flagged your account for immediate review by our security and billing teams. Please do not share any payment details via email. A specialist will contact you within 1 business hour to investigate this charge and process any necessary refunds. In the meantime, we recommend changing your account password as a precaution.

content:
Subject: Account locked after too many login attempts

Body:
My account got locked after I mistyped my password a few times. I need to get back into my account urgently as I have a presentation in 2 hours. Can you unlock it?
human_approved_draft: We've unlocked your account and you should now be able to log in. For security, we recommend resetting your password after logging in. If you've forgotten your password, use the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. If you still can't access your account, please let us know immediately.

content:
Subject: Integration with Slack not working

Body:
We've set up the Slack integration as per the documentation but messages are not being sent to our Slack channel. The webhook URL is configured correctly and we've tested it with a direct curl request. Could you help us troubleshoot?
human_approved_draft: Thank you for reaching out about the Slack integration issue. Here are some steps to troubleshoot: 1. Verify the webhook URL matches exactly in both systems, 2. Check that the Slack app has the correct permissions (chat:write), 3. Ensure the integration is enabled in your account settings. If the issue persists, please share the error logs from your integration settings page.
